Wishes you a wonderful day

Partner with Stripe

Join a strong global community of localized payment method partners to offer your payment solutions, market your payment method, and grow your business on Stripe.

The Payment Method Track is currently invite-only, so we’ll review your application to see if you’re a good fit. Tell us about your solution, and we'll get back to you with next steps.

About

Stripe's payment method partners can access our Payment Method Track to integrate, launch, and grow their business on Stripe. Through this program, your payment method can be accessed by Stripe users to help them improve their payments experience.

Once you apply, we’ll review your application for initial eligibility requirements, and we may reach out to a book discovery workshop to learn more about your payment method and share additional details about the program.

Join the Stripe Payment Method Track to access:

Stripe merchants and platforms that want to use your payment method

Guidelines and toolkits to launch your payment method on Stripe

Resources and training on Stripe and our products to help you scale

Marketing opportunities as a Stripe Verified Partner

Access to Stripe events

Program eligibility

To be eligible for Stripe's Payment Method Track, you'll need to meet our core requirements. We’ll assess these, in addition to other information about your business and payment method, as part of your program application process.

**Show qualified Stripe user demand**: Provide at least five existing or new-to-Stripe users who want to use your payment method via Stripe.

**Have a supportable use case**: Stripe has regulatory and product compliance requirements, so we’ll need to make sure your payment method is supportable on our platform.

**Meet core program prerequisites:** Stripe has certain requirements, such as settlement timing and dispute rate thresholds, to help us provide a great user experience. You’ll need to adhere to these as part of the program.

**Sign program agreement**: To become a partner, you’ll need to sign our partner program agreement.

**Complete technical certification**: As part of launching your payment method, you’ll complete end-to-end testing to make sure the integration meets our technical standards.

**Meet technical performance SLAs:** An excellent user experience is paramount to Stripe. You’ll need to adhere to performance SLAs on an ongoing basis once your payment method is live on the platform.

Apply for Stripe's Payment Method Track
